patterns.name: ROUTING
patterns.activation: Always owned by Conductor when Orchestra chooses or changes specialist topology.
patterns.authority_rule: Routing changes workflow topology only and never expands execution authority.

patterns.name: PLANNING
patterns.activation: Use for real dependency decomposition, multi-step work, or material cross-domain sequencing.
patterns.authority_rule: Planning inherits planning_owner and domain scope; no global planner authority is created.

patterns.name: TOOL_REACT
patterns.activation: Use when external state, evidence retrieval, validation tools, or authorized mutation are required.
patterns.authority_rule: ACT inherits the selected specialist's mutation permissions and external-action gates.

patterns.name: REFLECTION_CRITIC
patterns.activation: Use only when a distinct evaluation function, evidence source, or authority adds decision value.
patterns.authority_rule: Critic behavior does not self-authorize implementation, validation, or transition.

patterns.name: MULTI_AGENT
patterns.activation: Use when at least two genuinely distinct subproblems, authorities, or evidence domains justify coordination cost.
patterns.authority_rule: Specialization does not imply parallelization; Conductor remains dispatcher and OEE controls active concurrency.
